policy: Keep destinations 1–53 fixed. Hand-place 54–91 among existing systems with irregular spacing. Preserve supported regional relationships; unresolved positions are game interpretations. Do not treat the old Broken Mirror projection as an exact astronomical atlas.

positions.name: Vintaak
positions.rationale: Vintaak is in Tholian space; preserve its relationship to the existing Tholia anchor.

positions.name: Epsilon Indi
positions.rationale: Epsilon Indi is a nearby real stellar system; this projection blends it into the existing Sol / Alpha Centauri neighborhood. Exact screen chart coordinates are not claimed.

positions.name: Harlak
positions.rationale: The Mirror resistance history establishes Harlak, not a precise location. Place it in an open core/border gap without asserting canonical coordinates.

positions.name: Risa
positions.rationale: Use the inhabited core travel neighborhood; published Risa quadrant placements conflict, so do not assert an exact sky location.

positions.name: Vega
positions.rationale: Vega is a real nearby star; keep it inside the retained core projection rather than putting it beyond Romulus. This is not a calibrated sky projection.

positions.name: Gorlan
positions.rationale: The destruction account does not locate Gorlan precisely. Use a core-border gap and keep Gorlan Station a separate destination.

positions.name: Kepler-174
positions.rationale: Kepler-174 is a more distant real stellar system. Use a peripheral chart position; the game map is not a common-distance astronomical scale.

positions.name: Priors World
positions.rationale: No exact Mirror coordinates are established. Blend the world into an open colonial/core gap.

positions.name: Tonnata
positions.rationale: The parasite reference establishes Tonnata VII, not its chart coordinates. An open frontier position is a game choice.

positions.name: Sorna
positions.rationale: The imperial epithet does not establish a coordinate. Place the system in an open outer-core gap.

positions.name: Wurna Minor
positions.rationale: Keep the ambiguous location as a region; its peripheral position is a game interpretation.

positions.name: Purmata
positions.rationale: Career-record geography is unresolved. Blend the entry into an open colonial arc.

positions.name: Elpha
positions.rationale: The computer reference does not establish a solar-system position. Keep a distinct outer survey region.

positions.name: Quam
positions.rationale: The computer reference does not establish a solar-system position. Keep a distinct outer survey region.

positions.name: Mintaka
positions.rationale: Use the existing Orion-side exploration area for the Mintaka adaptation. This is a licensed-style regional interpretation, not a claim that constellation membership fixes 3D proximity.

positions.name: Betazed
positions.rationale: Blend Betazed into the core-world neighborhood. Existing Broken Mirror anchors prevent a literal official-atlas projection.

positions.name: Talos
positions.rationale: Retain Talos as a peripheral exploration destination; no exact canonical distance is asserted.

positions.name: Tau Ceti
positions.rationale: Tau Ceti is a nearby real star; keep it in the retained Sol / Alpha Centauri neighborhood.

positions.name: Gorlan Station
positions.rationale: Gorlan Station is not established as orbiting the destroyed Gorlan world. Give the separate facility a navigable core location.

positions.name: Badlands
positions.rationale: The Badlands belong in the Bajoran / Cardassian border neighborhood, not the distant row previously used.

positions.name: Fowla
positions.rationale: Mirror Sisko operated in Fowla. Place it on the Bajoran / Alliance side as a regional inference, not a surveyed coordinate.

positions.name: Porathia
positions.rationale: Keep the asteroid-belt destination in a colonial frontier gap; the cover story does not fix an exact location.

positions.name: Ventar
positions.rationale: Bareil describes a Klingon escape here but admits embellishment. A Bajoran / Alliance-edge position is approximate.

positions.name: Organia
positions.rationale: Organia is near the Federation / Klingon border; adapt that relationship to the retained core and Klingon anchors.

positions.name: Dannus
positions.rationale: Dannus V is a Prime location deliberately adapted into the game. Its remote placement is not a claim about a Mirror chart.

positions.name: New Bajor
positions.rationale: The Prime colony is in the Gamma Quadrant. Give its adapted counterpart a separated outer projection rather than pretending it is a neighbor of Bajor. This is compressed game geography, not a 70,000-light-year scale map.

positions.name: Pahvo
positions.rationale: Use the exploration / Klingon-border side for the Pahvo adaptation; exact placement remains illustrative.

positions.name: Kwejian
positions.rationale: Use a distinct outer exploration region for Kwejian, preserving its adapted identity without asserting exact Mirror coordinates.

positions.name: 61 Ursae Majoris
positions.rationale: 61 Ursae Majoris is the identified primary in Archer IV geography. Blend the early Earth colony into the nearby-core projection.

positions.name: Archer's Planet
positions.rationale: The archive gives Gamma Trianguli sector, which is not the Gamma Quadrant. Use an exploration frontier position and do not merge it with Archer IV.

positions.name: C-111
positions.rationale: C-111 / Beta III stays a single system. Its local chart placement is an open exploration gap, not verified screen coordinates.

positions.name: Eminiar
positions.rationale: Place the Eminiar / Vendikar system on the exploration edge; the conflict history does not supply a precise Mirror position.

positions.name: Sherman
positions.rationale: Sherman's Planet is a disputed Federation / Klingon border destination. Place it along the same border neighborhood as Organia.

positions.name: Tellar
positions.rationale: Blend the Tellarite home system into the retained founding-world neighborhood. Do not overwrite the original Andorian or Vulcan positions.

positions.name: Denobula
positions.rationale: Use the nearby Vulcan / Andorian exploration neighborhood for Denobula; this is approximate within the fixed legacy map.

positions.name: Coridan
positions.rationale: Blend Coridan into the inhabited core neighborhood while retaining every existing anchor.

positions.name: Clarus
positions.rationale: Clarus is a neighboring system of Ferenginar; retain that relationship in the blended map.

positions.name: Irtok
positions.rationale: Irtok is a neighboring system of Ferenginar; retain that relationship in the blended map.
